claim: West Flanders 2025 Michelin star list: 3* Boury (Roeselare); 2* Bartholomeus (Heist), Castor (Beveren-Leie), De Jonkman (Sint-Kruis), La Durée (Izegem); plus ~17 1* including Table d'Amis (Kortrijk), Rebelle (Marke), Hostellerie St-Nicolas (Elverdinge), Sel Gris and Cuines 33 (Knokke).
quote: Three Stars: Boury (Roeselare)... Two Stars: Bartholomeus (Heist-aan-Zee), Castor (Beveren-Leie), De Jonkman (Sint-Kruis), La Durée (Izegem)... One Star: ...Hostellerie St-Nicolas (Elverdinge)... Rebelle (Marke)... Table d'Amis (Kortrijk)

claim: In the 2026 Michelin Guide Belgium, Cuines 33 (Knokke) was promoted to 2 stars, joining the previously 2-star Castor, Bartholomeus, De Jonkman in West Flanders.
quote: Cuines 33 and The Jane awarded Two Stars in the MICHELIN Guide Belgium and Luxembourg 2026

claim: Cuines 33 in Knokke received its second Michelin star in the 2026 Belgium guide announced May 2026.
quote: Second Michelin star for The Jane and Cuines 33

claim: Boury (3*, Roeselare) tasting Menu Boury is €335; standard wine pairing €145, exclusive €280; non-alcoholic and beer pairings also offered; à la carte not served Fri/Sat night.
quote: Menu Boury... €335... Standard pairing: €145... Exclusive wines: €280... non-alcoholic pairing, in which fruits, herbs, and vegetables are translated... À la carte... not served on friday and saturday night

claim: Boury offers 3 on-site guest rooms (Beluga, Sevruga, Oscietra) at €250/night incl. breakfast (rising to €300 from May 2026); plus 'The Loft' at €500–€750; a 'Bed & Boury' dinner+room package exists but guest rooms close in August 2026.
quote: Beluga: €250 (€300 from May 2026)... PRICES ARE PER ROOM AND INCLUDE BREAKFAST IN THE ROOM... DO NOT HESITATE TO CONTACT US IF YOU WANT TO DISCOVER OUR BED&BOURY PACKAGE... Guest rooms will cease operations in August 2026

claim: Boury opening hours: closed Sun–Tue; open Wed–Sat 12:00–13:00 and 19:00–20:00; phone +32 51 62 64 62; Rumbeeksesteenweg 300, 8800 Roeselare.
quote: Sunday-Tuesday: Closed; Wednesday-Saturday: 12PM-1PM, 7PM-8PM... +32 51 62 64 62... Rumbeeksesteenweg 300, Roeselare

claim: Boury serves both lunch and dinner Wed–Sat including Saturday evening, confirming the slot needed for the trip anchor.
quote: Lunch and Dinner: Wed – Sat

claim: Boury's three guest rooms (Beluga/Sevruga/Oscietra) sit immediately on the restaurant site with check-in from 4pm, so dinner guests can walk a few metres to bed.
quote: Three guest rooms (called Beluga, Sevruga and Oscietra) offer bed and breakfast... €250 per room including breakfast in the room. Check-in starts at 4pm

claim: Izegem to Roeselare road distance is ~9–10 km (driving), straight-line ~7 km — well within the 30 km radius and ~15 min by car.
quote: driving distance is 9.6 km and the straight-line distance is 7 km

claim: Castor (2*, Beveren-Leie/Waregem) on Friday/Saturday evenings serves only the 7-course Terroir menu at €195 (+€305 with 6 wines); vegetarian 7-course €185 (+€300); cheese +€20, dessert wine pairing +€17.
quote: 7 Courses: €195-€305 (+6 wines)... Friday/Saturday evenings and holidays restricted to 7-course service only... Prices apply until the end of July 2026

claim: Castor has no on-site rooms; recommended sleep options are 4–8 km away (B&B La Maison des Papillons Deerlijk 4 km, Blue Woods Hotel Deerlijk 5 km, Hotel T Waregem 7 km, Hotel Messeyne Kortrijk 8 km, B&B Ter Wallen Izegem 12 km), none truly walking distance.
quote: B&B La Maison des Papillons (4 km) - Deerlijk; Blue Woods Hotel (5 km) - Deerlijk; Hotel T (7 km) - Waregem... B&B Ter Wallen (12 km) - Izegem

claim: Castor address Kortrijkseweg 164, 8791 Waregem (Beveren-Leie); closed Sun/Mon/Tue; phone +32 56 19 01 21, chef Maarten Bouckaert; reservations at cas-tor.be/en/reservation.
quote: Kortrijkseweg 164, 8791 Waregem... Closed on Sundays, Mondays and Tuesdays... +32 56 19 01 21 | info@cas-tor.be

claim: Table d'Amis (1*, Kortrijk, Sint-Maartenskerkhof 8) Saturday dinner only serves the 6-course menu at €135; weekday 4-course menu €100; closed Sun and Mon.
quote: Only the 6-course menu at 135 euros is served on Saturday evening, and on the other evenings, it is also possible to choose a 4-course menu for 100 euros

claim: Table d'Amis is temporarily closed for renovations until summer 2026 — so it is NOT a viable anchor for a near-term Saturday booking.
quote: The restaurant is temporarily closed for renovations until summer 2026

claim: Rebelle (1*, Marke) tasting menus €128 (6-course) and €165 (7-course, fixed Friday evenings); 3-course lunch €66 — and Saturday service is lunch-only per other sources.
quote: 6 courses: €128.00 (not Friday evening)... 7 courses: €165.00 (always available, fixed menu Friday evening)

claim: Rebelle Saturday hours are restricted to lunch (12:00–12:30) only, so it cannot anchor a Saturday-evening Michelin dinner.
quote: Hours are from noon to 1:15pm and 7pm to 8pm, with Saturday service limited to noon to 12:30pm only

claim: Hostellerie St-Nicolas (1*, Elverdinge near Ieper, Veurnseweg 532) opens Sat 12:00–13:30 and 19:00–20:30 — Saturday dinner confirmed; phone +32 57 20 06 22.
quote: Saturday 12pm-1:30pm & 7pm-8:30pm... Veurnseweg 532, 8906 Elverdinge (Ypres)... +32 (0)57 20 06 22

claim: Hostellerie St-Nicolas has 6 on-site rooms and sells dinner+stay packages: 4-course + room + breakfast €270 pp (double); 6-course version €360 pp; weekend €600 pp — restaurant and hotel are co-located in the same villa.
quote: 4-course menu package with 1 overnight stay and breakfast costs €270 per person (2 pers./room)... 6-course menu package with 1 overnight stay and breakfast costs €360 per person... gastronomic weekend with 2 overnight stays costs €600 per person

claim: De Jonkman (2*, Sint-Kruis/Bruges, Maalsesteenweg 438) is open Wed–Sat for lunch and dinner — viable but at the outer edge of scope (~45 km from Izegem via Bruges).
quote: Lunch and dinner are served Wednesday through Saturday

claim: Hostellerie Vijfwegen Bis and Hotel Vijfwegen in Rumbeke (Roeselare) sit within a ~10-minute walk of Boury — practical fallback once Boury's own rooms close in August 2026.
quote: the hotel is in the small village of Rumbeke, there's more choice than expected for dining... Boury Restaurant is within 10 minutes walk
